headline: On October 13, 1983: Ameritech launches first US cellular network
captionCards: Marked the start of the mobile revolution
instagramCaption:
Ameritech Mobile Communications makes history in Chicago. \\[Ameritech Mobile Communications launched the first U.S. cellular network in Chicago on October 13, 1983. This pioneering company was a division of Ameritech, which later became the holding company for several Bell companies in the Great Lakes region. By 1986, Cincinnati Bell held a 45% stake in the company. The launch marked the beginning of mobile phone service for the general public in the U.S.\\Today, this event is remembered as the start of the mobile revolution.\\What do you think was the most significant impact of this launch?\\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
